messages:
maria: Starting a focused dry-run of the dialback/admission logic against eu-west-1 GPU pool. Goal: confirm we see graceful shedding at 90% GPU alloc and queue depth > 500ms. Kicking off loadgen now (will run 12m).

josh: copy. which config are you using?

maria: using the variant from last week's experiment: `admission.window_ms=1000`, `admission.max_queue=2000`, `admission.target_util=0.9`. payloads mimic 1-5k token responses (avg 1.2k). command: `./loadgen --pattern surge --rps 12000 --burst 3000 --duration 12m --region eu-west-1`

dev-loadgen: loadgen started. immediate ramp to 12k rps over 30s, sustained bursts every 2m. reporting first metrics in 60s.

kai: heads-up: we saw queue depth spike to ~1.6k within 45s in the last run and a small increase in tail latency. watch `admission_dropped` counter.

sre-bot: [ALERT] eu-west-1: avg queue wait > 800ms (1m) — count 438. CPU on router-proxy at 92%.

maria: thanks — pulling metrics: `admission_dropped` increments started at 00:01:30, ~1.2k drops in first 3m. tail p95 token latency for served requests = 1.1s, p99 = 2.8s. 429 rate only ~0.6% because admission is dropping before rate limiter.

josh: that sounds like desired behavior (drop vs overload). can you paste the admission log snippet?

maria: log excerpt:
```
[1864009898] admission: enqueue ok, queue_len=34
[1864009905] admission: enqueue ok, queue_len=542
[1864009912] admission: enqueue rejected, reason=queue_timeout, queue_len=1623
[1864009938] admission: dropped request, reason=admission_dropped, controller=target_util
[1864009947] admission: fallback to lower-capacity model variant, model=redwood-lite-1
```

kai: interesting that `fallback to lower-capacity model variant` kicked in — are we using model-variant fallback in eu-west? thought that was disabled for this pool.

maria: it is enabled via policy `regional-fallback=true` for eu-west small fleets. should we disable for this run to isolate admission-only behavior?

sam: i'd leave fallback on for one run, then run again with it off. measure delta in `served_tokens` and `error_rate` and cost delta (we care about late-stage tail latency vs cost).

dev-loadgen: second pass started with `--disable-fallback` flag. ramping.

sre-bot: [INFO] admission_dropped increased faster this run (3.4k in first 5m). queue wait p50=720ms, p95=1.5s. 429s climbed to 1.9%.

maria: raw numbers from prometheus (first 6m):
- served_requests: 24,312
- admission_dropped: 3,432
- fallback_count: 0 (confirming disabled)
- avg_gpu_util: 91.3%
- regional_cost_estimate (6m extrap): +12% on spot vs baseline

josh: we should tune `admission.window_ms` down to 700ms and retry? shorter window => faster rejections and lower queue latency maybe. but higher immediate 429s. thoughts?

kai: set up small sweep: window_ms=[500,700,1000], max_queue=[1000,2000], measure p95 lat and admission_dropped. automated jobs?

maria: running param sweep: 3 configs, each 6m. queued run for next hour. i'll post summarized metrics after each.

sam: remember to capture `inflight_kv_cache` hit rates — fallback and model-variant changes depend on KV cache pressure. also capture `cost_per_served_token`.

maria: noted. adding `kvcache.hit_ratio`, `served_tokens`, `cost_estimate` to job.

dev-loadgen: sweep run complete: brief summary:
- cfg A (500ms, 1000): p95=890ms, admission_dropped=5.2k, 429=3.1%
- cfg B (700ms, 2000): p95=1.02s, admission_dropped=3.8k, 429=2.1%
- cfg C (1000ms, 2000): p95=1.4s, admission_dropped=2.1k, 429=0.9%

maria: early takeaways: config B seems like best balance (p95 ~1s, moderate drops). cost delta between A/B/C small vs baseline (within 15%), but A increased tail retries and user-visible 429s.

josh: agree. we should propose B to policy team as default for eu-west-1 temporarily. we need an action item to update dashboards & SLO notes.

kai: one more note: network egress on some shard nodes spiked during bursts — increased retransmits. want to check NIC queuing and TC settings. could be amplifying queue depth at proxy layer.

maria: logged infra ticket: INFRA-4456 to investigate NIC queue settings and possible BPF offload tweaks. tagging @netinfra.

sre-bot: [ACTION] Created incident INFRA-4456 assigned to netinfra.

sam: nice run. please also snapshot loadgen config and store under run-1864009876 for reproducibility.

maria: done — artifacts uploaded to S3 `s3://redwood-loads/1864009876/` (configs, prometheus snapshots, logs). next steps: roll config B to canary for 2h on 10% of traffic, observe user-facing 429s and SLOs.

josh: thumbs up. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks team — closing thread, will update once canary is live.
